description: DARTS, the Delft Advanced Research Terra Simulator, models coupled subsurface flow, heat and chemical processes using operator-based linearisation. The openDARTS project provides a Python-accessible parallel simulation implementation. The provider is TU Delft openDARTS team. Coverage: The software is generic to hydrocarbon, geothermal and subsurface-storage problems. User-defined grids and time settings determine coverage and resolution. Access: The provider links its public project and package documentation. No model, library or dependency was installed. Licence and cost: The project distinguishes Apache 2.0 source from GPLv3 binaries and separately lists third-party component licences. Limitations: Some chemistry backends require optional dependencies. The source and binary licences differ, and no numerical verification was performed. For simulation it supports forward and inverse geo-energy models and uncertainty studies. Related resources: model-geophires-x is a separate geothermal assessment tool. Existing food-system records using the acronym DARTS are unrelated.
